options.name: auth_token
options.description: InfluxDB authentication token.

options.name: bucket
options.description: InfluxDB bucket name.

options.name: enable_ha
options.description: Enable the high availability functionality. Only valid in a cluster setup.

options.name: enable_send_metadata
options.description: Whether to send check metadata e.g. states, execution time, latency etc.

options.name: enable_send_thresholds
options.description: Whether to send warn, crit, min & max tagged data.

options.name: file
options.description: Path to the file in which the object will be defined.

options.name: flush_interval
options.description: How long to buffer data points before transferring to InfluxDB.

options.name: flush_threshold
options.description: How many data points to buffer before forcing a transfer to InfluxDB.

options.name: host
options.description: InfluxDB host address.

options.name: host_template
options.description: Host template to define the InfluxDB line protocol.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the Influxdb2Writer object.

options.name: order
options.description: Value to determine internal precedence.

options.name: organization
options.description: InfluxDB organization name.

options.name: port
options.description: InfluxDB HTTP port.

options.name: service_template
options.description: Service template to define the InfluxDB line protocol.

options.name: ssl_ca_cert
options.description: Path to CA certificate to validate the remote host.

options.name: ssl_cert
options.description: Path to host certificate to present to the remote host for mutual verification.

options.name: ssl_enable
options.description: Whether to use a TLS stream.

options.name: ssl_insecure_noverify
options.description: Disable TLS peer verification.

options.name: ssl_key
options.description: Path to host key to accompany the ssl_cert.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the Influxdb2Writer object.
